sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain the division leaders and will be favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom with just 4 points and have won only once all season. This is a chance for the leaders to bounce back immediately.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach after their own recent loss. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth travel to Eccleshall in a mid-table clash between two sides in decent form. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on the table, visit Wednesfield Community on Saturday before facing Brereton Social in a midweek fixture on Wednesday—a demanding run that could impact their title credentials. Bilston Town (sixth) host Foley Meir in an encounter between mid-table teams. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a fixture between sides struggling in the lower half. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home on Saturday as both look to improve from their current positions. Shawbury United, currently on a six-game losing streak, host Barnton in a difficult assignment. Cheadle Heath Nomads face Telford Town in a basement clash, with both teams offering minimal resistance so far this season. Widnes Town, pointless after seven games, travel to Brereton Social—a fixture offering little hope given their dire form.
